title: LC-MT369-QueriesSearchAndLiveSubscriptions
clause: Restore complete Locus status, blocked, ready and search queries with scoped SurrealDB indexes and live subscriptions.

scope.summary: GOAL: Implement the missing Locus query surface on canonical SurrealDB data: get project/WP/MT status, query ready work, query blocked work, progress, dependency explanation, project-scoped search and event synchronization. Use declared indexes and bounded graph traversal rather than workspace-wide Rust scans. Scoped live subscriptions provide reactive taskboards and orchestration updates, include revision/cursor contracts, reconnect safely and trigger canonical resync on gaps. Loom may index typed links and descriptions, but query truth remains Locus.
forbidden_paths: Workspace-wide load-and-filter as the normal query path
Polling or LISTEN/NOTIFY replacing Surreal live queries
acceptance_criteria: Status, ready, blocked, progress, dependency and search operations cover every project kind and return project-qualified typed results from canonical Locus records.
Declared SurrealDB indexes and bounded graph queries meet measured representative latency/cardinality budgets without loading an entire workspace into application memory.
Live subscriptions are scoped by Principal/AccessSpace/project, carry revision cursors, reconnect without widening access and emit a typed gap requiring canonical resync.
Revoked access stops delivery and a subsequent reconnect cannot replay denied records or reveal hidden counts.
Loom-assisted search links back to canonical Locus identities and cannot override lifecycle, readiness or progress truth.
proof_targets: Real-Surreal query-catalog tests with representative project forests

enforcement_boundaries: Every query and subscription has explicit ResourceBroker scope.
Canonical Locus authorization is rechecked independently of Loom search visibility.
same_project_private_resource_cases: A same-project caller cannot query or subscribe to protected AccessSpace records, facets or counts.
cross_account_negative_cases: Cross-account callers cannot search, subscribe, replay cursors or infer result-count changes.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: Search results, facets, counts and live deltas cannot widen canonical Locus record visibility.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Revocation terminates delivery and invalidates replay rights; reconnect after context switch starts with fresh authorization.
metadata_side_channel_cases: Search facets, counts, latency differences, gap markers and subscription diagnostics exclude denied-record signals.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Record query class, scope hash, result count, latency, subscription cursor, gap and resync outcome.
Expose query-plan regressions, subscription lag, reconnect loops, cursor gaps and permission revocations.
Record DEFERRED-with-reason if query-latency and subscription-stall watchers are unavailable; never silently skip.

risk_if_missed: Locus remains operationally incomplete, slow at scale or privacy-unsafe under reactive multi-project workflows.

risks: Ready query omits a project kind.
A live query continues after revocation.

research_provenance.source: MT-361 operation audit, MT-339 Surreal knowledge/live-query contract, historical Locus query/search stubs and official SurrealDB index/live-query documentation.
research_provenance.selected_approach: Canonical indexed Surreal queries plus revisioned scoped live subscriptions and Loom typed search links.
